title: Remove corporate designators from unformed Lane A entity names across the repositories
objective: Bring every repository reference to the unformed Lane A entities into line with the principal's standing rule of 2026-09-10: no 'Inc.' or 'Corporation' on an organization that has not been incorporated.
human_gate: Principal approves each pull request before merge. This repository is public and its Pages deploy runs on merge, so a merged change is a publication.
acceptance: A hit list across every reachable repository for Inc, Incorporated, Corp, Corporation and LLC attached to a Lane A entity, with repository, path and line
Each designator removed or replaced with a neutral form such as '(formation pending)' - no new legal name asserted
Existing tests and builds for each touched repository still pass, including the command-center vitest suite this repo's command-center.yml runs
No merge. One pull request per repository, left for the principal
next_action: Re-run the designator search in every reachable repository, then open branch fix/unformed-entity-designators in each repository with a hit.
